data.label: Get More Calls
data.title:
5 website changes that
*bring more bookings*
data.sub: Swipe to check your own site →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: Make your *phone number* clickable
data.body: Customers on mobile devices won't copy and paste your number. Make it easy for them to call you instantly with one tap.
data.fix: Fix: Add a clickable 'tel' link to your header button.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: Add a *direct booking* button
data.body: People hate waiting for callbacks. Give them a way to schedule an appointment or quote while you are busy working.
data.fix: Fix: Link a booking tool to your main CTA button.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: Use *real photos* of work
data.body: Stock photos look fake and untrustworthy. Show your actual work so customers know exactly what quality to expect from you.
data.fix: Fix: Replace one stock photo with a real job photo.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: List your *service area* clearly
data.body: Don't make customers guess where you work. Clearly stating your city or county helps you get found by the right people.
data.fix: Fix: Put your service area in the website footer.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Show *customer reviews* prominently
data.body: Social proof builds trust faster than any sales pitch. Highlight happy feedback right where people land on your homepage.
data.fix: Fix: Add a section featuring 3 recent customer testimonials.
